newsitem.title: LATVIA: SOCCER-AUSTRIA SEAL WIN OVER LATVIA AFTER SLOW START.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRIA SEAL WIN OVER LATVIA AFTER SLOW START.

text.p: Austria scored three second-half goals to beat Latvia 3-1 in a European zone group four World Cup qualifier on Sunday.
After an evenly matched and scoreless first half, in which both teams missed some clear-cut scoring opportunities, the Austrians finally turned on the pressure after the break.
A corner kick yielded the first goal of the game to Austria's Andreas Heraf after 55 minutes, sparking new life into the visitors.
The Austrians dominated the rest of the game with Anton Polster scoring in the 81st minute and Peter Stoger adding their third four minutes later.
Vitali Astafjev scored a consolation goal for Latvia three minutes before full-time.
